# Meter

> Static range meter for quota, storage, score, or usage values.

This file matches the installed `meter` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/meter.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/meter.md`.

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

### Anatomy


## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Meter, MeterIndicator, MeterLabel, MeterTrack, MeterValue } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/meter";

export function PrimitiveMeterExample() {
  return (
    <Meter value={6.2} max={8} className="max-w-xs">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <MeterLabel>Storage used</MeterLabel>
        <MeterValue>{(_formatted, current) => `${current} GB of 8 GB`}</MeterValue>
      </div>
      <MeterTrack>
        <MeterIndicator />
      </MeterTrack>
    </Meter>
  );
}
```
